Pinch the 3D view or hold Shift while scrolling to zoom. With the view focused, +/− zoom and 0 resets to 65°. A narrower field of view gives finer drag and arrow-key control. Zoom changes the lens while keeping your position.

Display exposure · 1×
Starlight through dust

Illustrative dust dims and reddens stars seen through a cloud. Stars in front stay clear; diffuse emission keeps its separate, illustrative glow. Toggle to compare at the same paused view.
